_what: Recorded ceilings for the server-side ClaimGate lean tier. Every number here is MEASURED DEBT, not a target. A ceiling may only ever be LOWERED. Raising one to turn CI green erases the finding it records.
_measured_against: a CLEAN CHECKOUT of HEAD 87a56258bfd0db297604cc273c30dacd4edeb0d2 plus this change only, reproduced with `git archive HEAD | tar -x -C <tmp>`. That matters: the working tree carried 655 untracked claim-bearing receipts at measurement time, so a working-tree sweep reported 2876 receipts / 44 intake failures / 15 recompute vetoes while CI, which only ever sees committed files, reports 2221 / 34 / 14. Ceilings taken from a working tree would have shipped 655 receipts of free slack. A parallel session was committing to this branch during measurement, so re-measure all three numbers before merging.
_remeasure_cmd: git archive HEAD | tar -x -C /tmp/co && cd /tmp/co && python3 claimgate_plugin/ci_orphan_ratchet.py; python3 claimgate_plugin/ci_receipt_sweep.py --checker claimgate_plugin/intake_supervisor.py --scope all --max-failures 0; python3 claimgate_plugin/ci_receipt_sweep.py --checker claimgate_plugin/recompute_veto.py --scope all --max-failures 0
_enforcement_level: E2, supervised execution. Prevention is not available at E2: `git commit --no-verify` skips the local pre-commit gate, measured. These ceilings make DETECTION un-skippable instead.
_orphan_note: SUPERSEDED 2026-07-25. A COUNT is fungible: delete one historical orphan, add one new ungated receipt, total unchanged. The orphan ratchet now freezes the exact SET by path+sha256 in claimgate_plugin/ci_orphan_baseline.json (2851 entries). legacy_intake_failures_max and legacy_recompute_vetoes_max below are STILL COUNTS and carry the same fungibility defect — recorded as OPEN in claimgate_plugin/results/enforcement_attack_report_v1.json finding E9, not silently carried.
_legacy_intake_note: MEASURED on a clean HEAD checkout with --scope all: 2820 claim-bearing receipts swept, 34 intake rejections. 33 sit in the historical archives system_v4/v5/v6/v7 and work/hygiene_quarantine, which CLAUDE.md designates a read-only mine. The 34th, system_v8/nested_manifold/results/rungB/receipt.json, is LIVE-ERA and is also caught at zero tolerance by the claimgate-intake-live job. Failure classes: bare Infinity/NaN JSON literals, 'nan'/'inf' string tokens and null inside numeric evidence arrays, and one duplicate 'engine' key.
_legacy_recompute_note: MEASURED on a clean HEAD checkout with --scope all: 2820 swept, 14 vetoes. Do NOT read all 14 as science findings. Breakdown, classified by reading each message: 5 are false positives from recompute_veto.implicit_pairs matching the one-letter aggregate op 'n' against any key beginning with 'n' (norm_qt_plus_q0, nonselective_max_abs_error), so the gate compares a claimed norm against len(raw). 4 are fail-closed unparses of JSON-Lines files read as JSON ('Extra data: line 2 column 1'), an infra shape mismatch. 5 are candidate genuine mismatches, NOT adjudicated here: sum_delta_after_minus_before claimed 32.0 against sum 33.0 (x3) and n01_noncomm.max_abs_difference claimed 2.0 against max 1.0 (x2). Lowering this ceiling should START by tightening the 'n' heuristic, NOT by editing receipts. The live-era set has 0 recompute vetoes, so none of this noise reaches the zero-tolerance jobs.
